description_en: Modifies the name and description of a snapshot-consistent group
description_zh: 修改快照一致性组的名称与描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-snapshot-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --snapshot-group-id ssg-j6ciyh3k52qp7ovm0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySnapshotGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 快照一致性组所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210940.html to query snapshot-consistent group IDs
parameters.help_zh: 快照一致性组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210940.html查询快照一致性组ID
parameters.name: snapshot_group_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the snapshot-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), or colons (:)
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的快照一致性组名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、英文句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）或者半角冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description
